t: Gorilla Glue Epoxy Adhesive Clear 25ml provides a powerful, fast-setting solution for various bonding tasks. This clear epoxy glue is ideal for trade professionals needing reliable repairs on materials like metal, wood, ceramics, and most plastics. It sets in just 5 minutes, drying crystal clear, making it perfect for visible repairs or intricate work. The two-part formula is gap-filling, effectively bonding uneven surfaces and withstanding extreme temperatures and water. Easy-to-use syringe ensures precise application of resin and hardener, creating a durable, permanent bond essential for workshop and site applications.
